newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains end off highs on EU tender, stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains end off highs on EU tender, stg.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended firmer but off highs.
A disappointing EU tender result and a firmer sterling dampened sentiment in the later stages, one trader said.
There had been more optimism in earlier trade. "There's no farmer selling and shorts were keen to buy in," the trader said.
The EU wheat award of 170,000 tonnes was not enough to excite any enthusiasm in the market, he said.
Sterling moved above 3.0 marks in European trading.
March 1998 was most active on wheat, with 201 of the total 614 lots done. It last traded 0.25 stg higher at 89.00 stg. Its high of the day was 89.55 stg.
On barley, November was most active with 10 of the total 26 lots. It last traded 0.35 stg higher at 80.25 stg, down from a high 80.35 stg.
